paper.title: Social media use and loneliness in adolescents

paper_text:
Social media use and loneliness in adolescents
Ivanov, K., Dubois, C.  J. Fake Psychology, 2017

Abstract
Heavy social media use was linked to higher loneliness in 1,000 adolescents.

Results
Table 1 gives the correlations.

alerts.description: A retraction notice was published for this paper.

notice.text:
Retraction: Social media use and loneliness in adolescents

The journal has retracted this article because the survey data were found to be unreliable. The conclusions cannot be relied on.

draft_text:
A diary study of teen friendships

1. Introduction
Many studies have examined adolescents' online lives (Ivanov and Dubois, 2017; Lee, 2019; Moreau, 2020). Our study asks a different question: how friendships are maintained during exams.

2. Methods
We interviewed 20 students.

References
Ivanov, K., & Dubois, C. (2017). Social media use and loneliness in adolescents. J. Fake Psychology.
Lee, S. (2019). Teens online. J. Fake Media.
Moreau, A. (2020). Screens and sleep. J. Fake Health.
